title: Building an AI Language App with Flutter
description:
Looking for a chill but productive space to code, learn, and connect with other developers? Whether you’re just starting out or deep into a side project, you’re welcome here.

🚨 **Special Feature This Week: Building a Multi-Platform AI App**

This week features a deep dive by [Ethan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/huanglisen/), who will be walking us through exactly how he built Bantera ([https://bantera.app/](https://bantera.app/)), an English speaking and listening app.
He’ll be breaking down his stack and process:

* **The Cross-Platform Build:** How he engineered the backend and deployed the application across the web, iOS, and Android using Flutter.
* **The AI Integration:** His approach to wiring generative AI directly into the system to automatically output text, images, and audio.
* **The Product Design:** How he brought all the pieces together into a cohesive language-learning experience.

Alongside the demo, this remains a casual, community-driven space where you can:

* 💻 Work on your own coding projects
* 🎯 Share goals or progress (totally optional!)
* 🎙️ Talk tech, app development, and AI integration
* ☕ Meet like-minded people over coffee

Come with your laptop, your curiosity, or just a love for tech. Stay for the connections and good vibes.

☕ This event is hosted at a local café, so we kindly ask that you support the venue by purchasing a drink or snack if you can.
No pressure, no strict schedule—just code, coffee, AI, and vibes.
We usually hold meetups every fortnight (bi-weekly)—use them to connect, share, and learn from others.

For your deep work sessions between meetups, feel free to try NeonContext: a Voice AI tool designed to help you stay focused and hit your flow state. This is a tool developed within our community, so feel free to check it out and share your feedback! 💬 [https://www.neoncontext.com/](https://www.neoncontext.com/)

title: Practice Impromptu Speaking in a Casual and Friendly Environment
description:
**🚩 Important reminder:**
The spots are limited because we want to make sure that everyone gets a chance to speak and the group size stays comfy. If you RSVP "Going," your spot is guaranteed, but if your plans change, **please update** me or change your RSVP to "Not Going," so we can pass the spot to someone on the waitlist. **Repeated no-shows** may result in being prevented from RSVPing for future events. Thanks for helping us keep things smooth! 🙏🏼

**Join us for an evening of meaningful talks!**

We believe in fostering heartfelt connections and personal growth by sharing our life experiences. Come along and practice public speaking in an environment where kindness and authenticity are at the heart of everything we do. Everyone will have an opportunity to talk at every event. You're encouraged to take the stage and share your thoughts, you're also welcome to just watch and absorb the atmosphere, if that's more comfortable for you too.

**🤔 Who is this for?**

* **Complete beginners** who are keen to push their comfort zones and see what we're all about. There are **absolutely no expectations** in terms of public speaking experience or English fluency.
* **Intermediate speakers** looking for another forum to practice and improve amongst a like-minded community.
* **Advanced speakers** looking to polish their skills, experiment with ideas and approaches, and impart their wisdom to others!

**⚙️ How it works:**

1. Attendees put their name in the list to volunteer to take their turn and be given a random topic to talk about in front of everybody.
2. Deliver an impromptu talk on the given topic for 1-3 minutes (there will be a timer keeping you in check).
3. Receive immediate feedback from the audience. Feel free to request if you have an area you would like to have feedback on.

**🕔 Overview of evening:**
6:15pm - Arrive, settle down, buy a drink, chat and make friends
6:30pm - Start - Overview, Introductions and Impromptu talks
8:15pm - Feedback and wrap up

title: On Body and Soul (Hungary 2015, 1 hr 50)
description:
I am really excited about showing this film. It was nominated for the Academy Aaward for Best Foreign Language Film and won the Golden Bear Award at the Berlin International Film Festival.

The film depicts a romance in which two people share a re-occuring dream - that they are a pair of deer in a forest. The film is beautifully shot (you will love deer after this). A lot could be said about this film, but it takes us into world of autism and socially damaged indiividuals

The Fictionmachine reviewer wrote "technically it is superb. Cinematographer Máté Herbai turns every shot into a beautifully composed painting. The film’s use of colour is superb. The scenes of the two deer are remarkable to watch, and capture the animals in such an emotive fashion."

Some won't get it, but nothing new in thw world of cinema there!
